ammonia.reason: No extended proteolysis or deamination; fresh low-moisture block with minimal free NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk, defined thermophilic starter; no enteric or brevi p-cresol/indole/scatole.

bitter.reason: Very short age, limited hydrophobic peptide accumulation from camel/microbial chymosin.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; methyl ketones very low 2-heptanone 80 ug/kg, 2-nonanone 100 ug/kg.

browning.reason: Strong Maillard on pizza from residual galactose + whey protein in low-moisture matrix.

buttery.reason: Citrate metabolism by Streptococcus thermophilus gives diacetyl 2.59 mg/kg and acetoin 0.27 mg/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis; butanoic acid only 3.19 mg/kg and hexanoic 0.29 mg/kg, no rind flora.

creaminess.reason: Dense calcium-paracasein network with ~20% fat; firm-elastic rather than creamy.

crumbliness.reason: Aligned pasta-filata fibers deform, do not fracture into crumbs.

firmness.reason: Low-moisture 47-49% with stretched, salted paracasein gives firm sliceable block.

floral_honey.reason: No phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol reported; no floral lactones in fresh curd.

fruity.reason: Almost no ethyl esters; only trace methyl ketones from beta-oxidation of fatty acids.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only; no caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal and no aged pyrazine/nutty development.

melt.reason: pH 5.2-5.4 solubilizes colloidal calcium phosphate allowing para-casein flow on heating.

oil_off.reason: Heated fat coalescence in stretched matrix releases free oil as pizza topping.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no guaiacol or phenols from smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Thermophilic lactic + heterolactic acetic acid 11.08 mg/kg, pH ~5.3, free acidity as lactic.

stretch.reason: Hot-water stretching at ~71C aligns demineralized casein fibers into long strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Cook to 41C plus hot stretch denatures whey protein, retains sulfhydryls/H2S cooked-milk note.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose with low acid and diacetyl gives faint sweet-milky background.

umami.reason: Very short proteolysis; low free glutamate, no aged glutamyl peptide accumulation.
